# Pin ruff to the locked minor so lint results do not depend on the resolver

Carried from the issue 1020 code review (`docs/code-reviews/2026-09-19-issue-1020-board-vocabulary-code-review.md`,
round three, P3 findings, "A toolchain caveat on the inner-loop claim").

`pyproject.toml` declares `ruff>=0.4` while `uv.lock` resolves ruff 0.15.12. A reviewer
environment that resolved ruff 0.16.5 flagged pre-existing issues in files nobody touched
(`plugins/home-lab-ops` and some `docs/analysis` code blocks). Continuous integration can start
failing on untouched files the day the resolver moves to a newer minor.
